policyRows.reason: The reference AnalyzeRule.put/get ladder writes the bound chapter/book entity and falls back to the per-source row only when no entity is bound (AnalyzeRule.kt:856-891), while the product's java.put/java.get address the per-source v_ row (ADR 0011 section 3, ticket #21). That accepted difference stays out of this corpus: no script here calls java.get or java.put.
policyRows.owner: consumer declares its own product-policy checks over declared keys, outside the 26 frozen observation ids

policyRows.reason: AppConfig.tocCountWords defaults to true (AppConfig.kt:573-576), so the reference TOC reads the word-count token out of the updateTime rule and carries it on the chapter (BookChapterList.kt:236,251-260); the product store has no chapter wordCount column. Coverage gap, not a compared row.

The frozen document, attribute and getVariable values reach a script as Java-backed Strings, so a === comparison against a JS string literal does not hold on them. This corpus converts such a value with String(...) before comparing, so the declared writes are exercised as JS primitives. Interop between native-returned values and strict equality is left to #137 and this corpus accepts no difference on it.

The search stage binds its result Book as rule data in the reference (BookList.kt:45,55,163-174) and the product's search snapshot has no book, so this corpus calls only source.* in the search script and makes no new search-entity claim.

coverageGaps: One HTML source and one JSON source, three books, five chapter reads: a state/session comparison boundary, not a source or platform claim.
No login, cookie-jar write, cache byte payload, TLS exception, rate limiter, WebView, Java get/put or concurrency row.
No ruleToc.nextTocUrl or ruleContent.nextContentUrl pagination; each stage fetches one page per step.
Chapter wordCount carry and search-entity bindings are declared not-compared above.

sourceDerivedNotes.basis: Read from the selected reference tree at a7d37f1707a70a459ad708f4fe79341d1e42d716 and the call sites cited in publication and policyRows: WebBook.kt:53,202,297,395; Book.kt:473-479; BookInfoViewModel.kt:329-331,515,554; BookChapterDao.kt:37-38,49-50; BaseSource.kt:342-370; AnalyzeRule.kt:856-891. sourceDerivedNotes.seed: Library n becomes 1 at the first search script that runs initA/initB (idempotent, so the number of evaluations of ruleSearch.kind cannot change it) and every later script in the same process reads 1; a genuinely fresh process reads 0 from the library text.
sourceDerivedNotes.valueConversion: Every value a script compares with === is first converted with String(...): the frozen book/chapter fields and getVariable results are Java-backed Strings, and this corpus measures the variable lifecycle after that explicit conversion, not native-return interop (that stays with #137).
sourceDerivedNotes.restart: Book variables written by the details stage survive because Book.save() persisted them; chapter rows are replaced, so the retained key is rebuilt fresh and its pre-write read is empty; the replaced key's row is gone; A2 is never refreshed.
